description: Commissioner General of Inland Revenue Vs. Sri Lanka Insurance Corporation Limited Commissioner General of Inland Revenue Vs. Sri Lanka Insurance Corporation Limited View More before Hon. Dr. D. F. H. Gunawardhana, J.
parties: Commissioner General of Inland Revenue Vs. Sri Lanka Insurance Corporation Limited Commissioner General of Inland Revenue Vs. Sri Lanka Insurance Corporation Limited View More
judgement_by: Hon. Dr. D. F. H. Gunawardhana, J.
keywords: Consider whether National Building Tax (NBT) can be charged on the income derived from investment in financial services of the Respondent (life insurer), investing premia in sovereign bonds and treasury bills for the purpose of maintaining insurance funds; Sections 2 and 3 of the Nation Building Tax Act, No. 9 of 2009 and Section 25 of the Value Added Tax Act No. 14 of 2002 (as amended). Held – Respondent not liable to pay NBT as life insurance is an exempted service under the Act. Appeal dismissed without costs.
legistation: Section 11A of the Tax Appeals Commission Act No. 23 and 2011 (as amended).
